description: This Java interface defines the JsonFieldDefinition, which describes the schema of a JSON field including its key, type, markers, and methods for creating field definitions for various data types. It also includes methods for retrieving metadata and mapping JSON values to Java types.

classes.name: JsonFieldDefinition
classes.description: An interface representing the schema definition of a JSON field, including methods for creating field definitions for various data types, retrieving metadata, and mapping JSON values to Java types.

methods.name: ofString
methods.description: Creates a new JSON field definition for a String value given a JSON pointer and optional markers.

methods.name: ofInt
methods.description: Creates a new JSON field definition for an Integer value given a JSON pointer and optional markers.

methods.name: ofLong
methods.description: Creates a new JSON field definition for a Long value given a JSON pointer and optional markers.

methods.name: ofDouble
methods.description: Creates a new JSON field definition for a Double value given a JSON pointer and optional markers.

methods.name: ofBoolean
methods.description: Creates a new JSON field definition for a Boolean value given a JSON pointer and optional markers.

methods.name: ofJsonObject
methods.description: Creates a new JSON field definition for a JsonObject value given a JSON pointer and optional markers.

methods.name: ofJsonArray
methods.description: Creates a new JSON field definition for a JsonArray value given a JSON pointer and optional markers.

methods.name: ofJsonValue
methods.description: Creates a new JSON field definition for a JsonValue value given a JSON pointer and optional markers.

methods.name: getPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer that refers to this field definition.

methods.name: getValueType
methods.description: Returns the Java class type of the value of this field.

methods.name: getMarkers
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of markers associated with this field definition.

methods.name: isMarkedAs
methods.description: Checks if this field definition is marked with at least all specified markers.

methods.name: mapValue
methods.description: Maps a JsonValue to the Java type of this field definition, throwing an exception if incompatible.
